name: csr-companion
description: Claude Self-Reflect beside Claude: a pane that shows what your memory handed Claude this session, a side agent that asks "what if...?" when your past sessions give it a reason, and a heads up when Claude opens code that changed since you last worked on it

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.description: While Claude works, CSR's dreamer asks one "what if...?" when its memory gives a reason. It looks only when CSR has something new, slows down when it finds nothing, and checks before each look that its spend stays within 1 token for every 10 Claude spends. A look can still run over, since a fork takes no token cap; the next one waits until Claude has caught up.

autoCompact.title: Compact at the right moment
autoCompact.description: Compacting on its own is opt-in: choose auto for it. suggest (the default): at a quiet turn end once this session reaches 181k-269k, CSR offers to compact, and only your press compacts. auto: CSR compacts on its own, at a turn end with nothing running in the background and no question waiting, or at the next turn end past 269k; at the terminal it counts down 20 s first (1 compacts now, 0 or typing cancels), and from the phone or after 10 minutes away it compacts at once and leaves you a one-line note. off: never.
